notes.title: Women's History Month: Dev Livestream
notes.content:
We're celebrating women's history moth with a playthrough of our games by the devs.

Our dev team including our director and our writer will be doing a new playthrough of our game and reading out lines while discussing the development process.

For those in other timezones here's a breakdown:
GMT/BST — 9pm Fri March 1st 2024
EST/EDT — 5pm, Fri March 1st 2024
PST/PDT — 1pm, Fri March 1st 2024

Hoping to see you there if you can make it!

Much love,
Team Galens

notes.title: Sorcery Saturday: Dev Livestream
notes.content:
We've been selected to participate in the Storyteller's Festival and have decided to celebrate with an impromptu stream!

The artist/director and the writer of our game will be doing a special play-through of our demo while discussing the development process and shenanigans might ensue. 
What's even more fun is that our writer hasn't played the demo in full yet themselves so we might get some great reactions. Don't miss this unique event on Steam and join us this Saturday Feb 3rd at 6PM (BST) for some sorcery and magic as we play-through our fantasy visual novel (with RPG elements) and try to reach the end of the demo!

For those in other timezones here's a breakdown:
GMT/BST — 6pm Sat Feb 3rd 2024
EST/EDT — 1pm, Sat Feb 3rd 2024
PST/PDT — 10am, Sat Feb 3rd 2024

Hoping to see you there!

Much love,
Team Galens

notes.title: Dual Chroma: Male MC Addition + Kickstarter
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44261884/ba9467a3f5d94cccc939f01f9965d3c73e6cfb0e.jpg[/img]

Our [url=https://bit.ly/dckickstart]Kickstarter campaign[/url] for [i]Dual Chroma[/i] is now entering the final [b]20 hours[/b]! 

This is your chance to grab exclusive game goods and have a say in what the full game might contain - among the things we have yet to reach is a male MC stretch goal. Reaching this goal will give players the option to select the masc-presenting avatar as their customizable main character and see them in some CGs!

Link to the Kickstarter: https://bit.ly/dckickstart
